about: Retrieval-level eval for what the agent is shown before a turn. Each query is graded by whether the injected context contains the strings that answer it (must_include), leaks a string from another chat (must_exclude), and how often an answer is repeated. No model is called: the graph is built from canned triplets and search is FTS-only, so numbers are reproducible and say nothing about embedding quality.

notes.name: daemon-ports
notes.body: The daemon serves the web UI on port 18788 and the websocket gateway on port 18789. Space apps start from port 4800.

notes.name: old-space-app-ports
notes.body: Space apps used to start from port 4300 before the range moved.

notes.name: telegram-pairing
notes.description: how an unknown telegram chat is admitted
notes.body: Telegram pairing: an unknown chat gets an 8-character code and nothing is processed until a person approves it with pair approve CODE.

notes.body: Sao lưu cơ sở dữ liệu: chạy lệnh sao lưu mỗi đêm lúc 02:00, giữ bảy bản gần nhất trong thư mục backups.

notes.name: sandbox-egress
notes.description: how the macOS sandbox limits network access
notes.body: The OS sandbox on macOS uses Seatbelt; per-site network egress goes through an allowlisting proxy on loopback.

notes.name: daemon-logs
notes.body: Daemon logs go to the data folder and rotate daily.

notes.name: daemon-restart-bind-host
notes.description: restart after changing the bind host
notes.body: Restart the daemon after changing SENCLAW_UI_BIND_HOST; the listener address is fixed at start.

notes.name: daemon-update
notes.body: The senclaw update command downloads the release binary for the platform and replaces the daemon.

notes.name: staging-vault
notes.body: The staging admin password rotation happens every Friday and the vault item is called delta-vault.

projects.about: Facts that belong to a project. A project keeps its own bank (project:<id>) that every chat of the project reads and writes; the agent's common facts are the facts above (bank main, no chat). `windows` are retained into the project of `project` (p or q) the way the pool does it, in order; `queries` are asked `from` a chat, inside a project or not, and graded like the fact queries. A project fact must never reach a chat outside the project or in another one; the common facts must stay visible inside a project until it stops inheriting them; what is said in one chat of a project must be answerable in another; and a change of mind in one chat must replace what another chat said.
